notes:
Summary: Verdant runs a global media archive (news + user-generated video captions). Primary goal: accurate, low-latency archival search across very long documents (multi-thousand token transcripts). Wants to keep cost-per-query <= €0.02 ideally, 90th Pctl latency target sub-300ms for conversational flows. POC highlights: embedding-only baseline gave acceptable recall but frequent false positives on semantically-similar transcript chatter; adding a cross-encoder reranker improved MRR by ~+0.12 in our sample queries but increased tail latency and cost.

Index scale / ops: currently ~1.2M source docs -> ~15M chunks after semantic chunking (avg 1.8k tokens). Customer worried about storage + vector index RAM footprint and rebuild times. Asked about sharding strategies, incremental indexing, warm/cold tiers. Interested in HNSW/FAISS options + quantized vectors (8-bit/4-bit), and Redwood suggestions for cost vs recall tradeoffs.

Chunking strategy notes: customer favors semantic-boundary chunking (sentence/paragraph-aware) vs fixed-window. They observed loss of answer context when chunks cut mid-sentence. Also using overlap=200 tokens for reranker context; want guidance on chunk size vs recall/latency. We recommended variable chunking with adaptive overlap; suggested compressing long context via sentence-level dedup before chunking.

Retrieval + reranker tuning: current POC retrieval candidates=50 (ANN bi-encoder), rerank top_n=8 with cross-encoder. Cross-encoder latency measured ~120-250ms depending on batch size and GPU; cost per rerank higher (~3-4x embedding cost). Customer asked about alternative patterns: cascade reranking (lightweight cross-encoder distilled to tiny CE for top 20 then heavier reranker top 5), late-interaction models, or hybrid recall boosting using metadata filters.

Latency & cost: POC numbers (approx): embedding vector lookup + fetch ~15-30ms (per query at p99 depending on shards), cross-encoder rerank + GPU infer ~120-250ms for 8 items; overall 90th pct ~250-480ms depending on config. Cost ballpark: embedding generation ~€0.006/query, ANN lookup negligible infra cost but storage/ops amortized ~€0.005-0.01/query at scale, cross-encoder rerank ~€0.02-0.04/query. Customer aim: shave rerank cost by 40-60% while keeping MRR gains.

Security & compliance: EU data residency required; SOC2 + SSO/SAML mandatory. Asked about KMS integration and audit logging retention. Legal raised question about on-prem/private deployment for sensitive historical content.

Quotes / CRM fragments: "we need sub-300ms for chat flows"; "can't exceed €0.02/query on average without breaking unit economics"; "video transcripts are verbose — chunking is the pain point".

Current ask: detailed POC report with cost model (per-query at 10k qps/1M monthly queries), suggested Dedicated sizing (GPU types, shard layout), recommended reranker cascade strategies (distillation plan + fallback policies), and a security architecture doc for EU residency.

Next steps: send detailed cost sheet + Dedicated sizing by 2026-03-17; schedule legal call to close residency questions; set calendar for 2-week AB test on reranker variants.
